name: Kumeel Writings Guide
description: Answers questions about the published writings, ideas and library of Kumeel Al Nahab's site (kumeelalnahab.com), using only the site's own texts and citing the pages it used. Arabic first; also answers in English. It does not speak for Kumeel and gives no medical, legal or financial advice.

skills.name: Ask the writings
skills.description: Ask one question (up to 600 characters) about the site's philosophy, science and culture writings. Returns a short Socratic answer grounded in the site, links to the cited pages, and a follow-up question. Single turn; rate limited per client and per day.
examples: What do the writings say about certainty?
